The Mahila Mandal heads out to a hotel for lunch to celebrate. During the gathering, Daya suggests using the ₹1.6 lakh fund to buy a gold necklace that all the society women can share for special occasions, keeping it a surprise from their husbands.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
